<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_2056099_indust_0.WhatIfSimulationEngine</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>true</client_callable>
        <description>Digital Twin simulation and adaptive scheduling engine for industrial valve manufacturing.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>WhatIfSimulationEngine</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * WhatIfSimulationEngine
 *
 * Non-destructive simulation engine for production What-If analysis.
 * Reads live production data (orders, schedules, resources, materials)
 * and calculates simulated alternatives WITHOUT modifying any records.
 *
 * Supported scenario types:
 *   resource_down        – resource unavailable + adaptive rescheduling
 *   capacity_reduction   – resource capacity drops by X%
 *   quantity_change      – production order planned quantity changes
 *   material_shortage    – available stock drops by X%
 *   schedule_shift       – schedule start date shifts by N days
 */
var WhatIfSimulationEngine = Class.create();
WhatIfSimulationEngine.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    PO_TABLE: 'x_2056099_indust_0_production_order',
    SCHED_TABLE: 'x_2056099_indust_0_prod_sched',
    RES_TABLE: 'x_2056099_indust_0_prod_res',
    MAT_TABLE: 'x_2056099_indust_0_production_material',
    STOCK_TABLE: 'x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock',
    PRIORITY_RANK: { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 },

    simulate: function(params) {
        var type = params.scenario_type || '';
        if (!type) return { success: false, error: 'scenario_type is required' };

        var state = this._loadCurrentState();
        if (state.resources.length === 0 && state.schedules.length === 0) {
            return {
                success: true, empty: true,
                message: 'No active production resources or schedules found. Create production data to run simulations.',
                current: state.summary, simulated: state.summary,
                affectedOrders: [], affectedSchedules: [],
                impact: { totalDelayDays: 0, affectedOrderCount: 0, capacityImpactPct: 0 }
            };
        }

        var result;
        switch (type) {
            case 'resource_down': result = this._simulateResourceDown(state, params); break;
            case 'capacity_reduction': result = this._simulateCapacityReduction(state, params); break;
            case 'quantity_change': result = this._simulateQuantityChange(state, params); break;
            case 'material_shortage': result = this._simulateMaterialShortage(state, params); break;
            case 'schedule_shift': result = this._simulateScheduleShift(state, params); break;
            default: return { success: false, error: 'Unknown scenario_type: ' + type };
        }

        result.success = true;
        result.scenario = params;
        result.timestamp = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue();
        result.current = state.summary;
        return result;
    },

    /* ════════════════════ State Loader ════════════════════ */

    _loadCurrentState: function() {
        var resources = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.RES_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            resources.push({
                sys_id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                name: gr.getValue('resource_name'),
                status: gr.getValue('status'),
                statusDisplay: gr.getDisplayValue('status'),
                capacity_per_day: parseFloat(gr.getValue('capacity_per_day')) || 0,
                efficiency: parseFloat(gr.getValue('efficiency_percentage')) || 100,
                maintenance_required: gr.getValue('maintenance_required') == '1',
                resource_type: gr.getDisplayValue('resource_type')
            });
        }

        var schedules = [];
        gr = new GlideRecord(this.SCHED_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('status', 'IN', 'draft,scheduled,confirmed,in_progress');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var start = new GlideDateTime(gr.getValue('planned_start'));
            var end = new GlideDateTime(gr.getValue('planned_end'));
            var durationMs = GlideDateTime.subtract(start, end).getNumericValue();
            var durationDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(durationMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
            schedules.push({
                sys_id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                number: gr.getValue('number'),
                production_order: gr.getValue('production_order'),
                production_order_display: gr.getDisplayValue('production_order'),
                resource_id: gr.getValue('production_resource'),
                resource_display: gr.getDisplayValue('production_resource'),
                planned_start: gr.getDisplayValue('planned_start'),
                planned_end: gr.getDisplayValue('planned_end'),
                planned_start_val: gr.getValue('planned_start'),
                planned_end_val: gr.getValue('planned_end'),
                planned_quantity: parseFloat(gr.getValue('planned_quantity')) || 0,
                status: gr.getValue('status'),
                statusDisplay: gr.getDisplayValue('status'),
                priority: gr.getValue('priority'),
                duration_days: durationDays
            });
        }

        var orders = [];
        gr = new GlideRecord(this.PO_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('status', 'NOT IN', 'completed,cancelled');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            orders.push({
                sys_id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                number: gr.getValue('number'),
                status: gr.getValue('status'),
                statusDisplay: gr.getDisplayValue('status'),
                quantity_planned: parseFloat(gr.getValue('quantity_planned')) || 0,
                quantity_produced: parseFloat(gr.getValue('quantity_produced')) || 0,
                quantity_remaining: parseFloat(gr.getValue('quantity_remaining')) || 0,
                finished_product: gr.getDisplayValue('finished_product'),
                priority: gr.getValue('priority'),
                assigned_resource: gr.getValue('assigned_resource'),
                assigned_resource_display: gr.getDisplayValue('assigned_resource')
            });
        }

        return {
            resources: resources, schedules: schedules, orders: orders,
            summary: {
                totalResources: resources.length,
                availableResources: resources.filter(function(r) { return r.status === 'available'; }).length,
                activeSchedules: schedules.length,
                activeOrders: orders.length
            }
        };
    },

    /* ════════════════ Resource Down + Adaptive Rescheduling ════════════════ */

    _simulateResourceDown: function(state, params) {
        var resId = params.target_resource_id;
        var days = parseInt(params.duration_days) || 1;
        if (!resId) return { success: false, error: 'target_resource_id is required' };

        var resource = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < state.resources.length; i++) {
            if (state.resources[i].sys_id === resId) { resource = state.resources[i]; break; }
        }
        if (!resource) return { success: false, error: 'Resource not found' };

        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var downEnd = new GlideDateTime(now);
        downEnd.addDaysLocalTime(days);

        // ── 1. Identify affected schedules ──
        var affectedRaw = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < state.schedules.length; j++) {
            var sched = state.schedules[j];
            if (sched.resource_id !== resId) continue;
            var schedStart = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_start_val);
            var schedEnd = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_end_val);
            if (schedStart.compareTo(downEnd) < 0 && schedEnd.compareTo(now) > 0) {
                affectedRaw.push(sched);
            }
        }

        if (affectedRaw.length === 0) {
            return {
                simulated: {
                    totalResources: state.summary.totalResources,
                    availableResources: state.summary.availableResources - 1,
                    activeSchedules: state.summary.activeSchedules,
                    activeOrders: state.summary.activeOrders
                },
                affectedSchedules: [],
                affectedOrders: [],
                adaptiveProposals: [],
                impact: { affectedOrderCount: 0, totalDelayDays: 0, capacityImpactPct: 0,
                    resourceName: resource.name, downtimeDays: days,
                    reassignedCount: 0, unrecoverableCount: 0 }
            };
        }

        // ── 2. Sort affected by priority (reuse ProductionScheduler pattern) ──
        var self = this;
        affectedRaw.sort(function(a, b) {
            var ra = self._getPriorityRank(a.priority);
            var rb = self._getPriorityRank(b.priority);
            if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb;
            var sa = new GlideDateTime(a.planned_start_val);
            var sb = new GlideDateTime(b.planned_start_val);
            return sa.compareTo(sb);
        });

        // ── 3. Build virtual schedule map (in-memory) ──
        // Maps resource_id → array of { start_val, end_val } representing occupied slots.
        // Initialized from ALL live schedules (excluding those on the failed resource).
        var virtualSlots = {};
        for (var s = 0; s < state.schedules.length; s++) {
            var sc = state.schedules[s];
            if (sc.resource_id === resId) continue; // skip failed resource
            if (!virtualSlots[sc.resource_id]) virtualSlots[sc.resource_id] = [];
            virtualSlots[sc.resource_id].push({
                start_val: sc.planned_start_val,
                end_val: sc.planned_end_val
            });
        }

        // ── 4. Find candidate resources (reuse ProductionScheduler feasibility rules) ──
        var candidateResources = [];
        for (var c = 0; c < state.resources.length; c++) {
            var cr = state.resources[c];
            if (cr.sys_id === resId) continue;  // exclude failed resource
            if (cr.status !== 'available') continue;
            if (cr.maintenance_required) continue;
            if (cr.capacity_per_day <= 0) continue;
            candidateResources.push(cr);
        }

        // ── 5. Adaptive rescheduling: process each affected schedule in priority order ──
        var proposals = [];
        var affectedSchedules = [];
        var reassignedCount = 0;
        var unrecoverableCount = 0;
        var totalDelayBefore = 0;
        var totalDelayAfter = 0;

        for (var a = 0; a < affectedRaw.length; a++) {
            var aff = affectedRaw[a];
            var poId = aff.production_order;

            // Find the production order for this schedule
            var order = null;
            for (var o = 0; o < state.orders.length; o++) {
                if (state.orders[o].sys_id === poId) { order = state.orders[o]; break; }
            }

            var delayBefore = days;
            totalDelayBefore += delayBefore;

            var delayedEnd = new GlideDateTime(aff.planned_end_val);
            delayedEnd.addDaysLocalTime(days);

            // Record the basic affected schedule info
            var affEntry = {
                schedule_number: aff.number,
                order_display: aff.production_order_display,
                resource_display: aff.resource_display,
                current_start: aff.planned_start,
                current_end: aff.planned_end,
                simulated_end: delayedEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                delay_days: days,
                status: aff.statusDisplay,
                priority: aff.priority
            };
            affectedSchedules.push(affEntry);

            // Try to find an alternative resource
            var bestCandidate = null;
            var bestStart = null;
            var bestEnd = null;
            var bestDays = 0;

            for (var r = 0; r < candidateResources.length; r++) {
                var cand = candidateResources[r];
                var effectiveCapacity = cand.capacity_per_day * (cand.efficiency / 100);
                if (effectiveCapacity <= 0) continue;

                var daysNeeded = Math.ceil(aff.planned_quantity / effectiveCapacity);
                if (daysNeeded < 1) daysNeeded = 1;

                // Find earliest slot on this candidate using virtual schedule
                var slot = this._findEarliestVirtualSlot(
                    cand.sys_id, daysNeeded, now, virtualSlots
                );

                if (!slot) continue;

                // Pick the candidate with the earliest start, then highest capacity
                if (!bestCandidate ||
                    slot.start.compareTo(bestStart) < 0 ||
                    (slot.start.compareTo(bestStart) === 0 && effectiveCapacity > bestCandidate.effectiveCapacity)) {
                    bestCandidate = {
                        sys_id: cand.sys_id,
                        name: cand.name,
                        capacity_per_day: cand.capacity_per_day,
                        efficiency: cand.efficiency,
                        effectiveCapacity: effectiveCapacity,
                        resource_type: cand.resource_type
                    };
                    bestStart = slot.start;
                    bestEnd = slot.end;
                    bestDays = daysNeeded;
                }
            }

            if (bestCandidate) {
                // Register this assignment in the virtual schedule to prevent overlaps
                if (!virtualSlots[bestCandidate.sys_id]) virtualSlots[bestCandidate.sys_id] = [];
                virtualSlots[bestCandidate.sys_id].push({
                    start_val: bestStart.getValue(),
                    end_val: bestEnd.getValue()
                });

                var adaptiveDelay = 0;
                var origStart = new GlideDateTime(aff.planned_start_val);
                if (bestStart.compareTo(origStart) > 0) {
                    var delayMs = GlideDateTime.subtract(origStart, bestStart).getNumericValue();
                    adaptiveDelay = Math.ceil(delayMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                }
                totalDelayAfter += adaptiveDelay;

                proposals.push({
                    schedule_number: aff.number,
                    order_display: aff.production_order_display,
                    priority: aff.priority,
                    original_resource: aff.resource_display,
                    proposed_resource: bestCandidate.name,
                    proposed_resource_type: bestCandidate.resource_type,
                    proposed_capacity: bestCandidate.capacity_per_day,
                    proposed_efficiency: bestCandidate.efficiency,
                    current_start: aff.planned_start,
                    current_end: aff.planned_end,
                    proposed_start: bestStart.getDisplayValue(),
                    proposed_end: bestEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                    proposed_duration_days: bestDays,
                    delay_before_adaptation: delayBefore,
                    delay_after_adaptation: adaptiveDelay,
                    delay_recovered: delayBefore - adaptiveDelay,
                    feasible: true,
                    reassigned: true,
                    reason: 'Reassigned from ' + resource.name + ' to ' + bestCandidate.name
                });
                reassignedCount++;
            } else {
                totalDelayAfter += delayBefore;
                var reasons = [];
                if (candidateResources.length === 0) {
                    reasons.push('No alternative resources are active, available, and have capacity');
                } else {
                    reasons.push('All ' + candidateResources.length + ' candidate resource(s) have scheduling conflicts or insufficient slots');
                }

                proposals.push({
                    schedule_number: aff.number,
                    order_display: aff.production_order_display,
                    priority: aff.priority,
                    original_resource: aff.resource_display,
                    proposed_resource: null,
                    current_start: aff.planned_start,
                    current_end: aff.planned_end,
                    proposed_start: aff.planned_start,
                    proposed_end: delayedEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                    delay_before_adaptation: delayBefore,
                    delay_after_adaptation: delayBefore,
                    delay_recovered: 0,
                    feasible: false,
                    reassigned: false,
                    reason: reasons.join('. ')
                });
                unrecoverableCount++;
            }
        }

        return {
            simulated: {
                totalResources: state.summary.totalResources,
                availableResources: state.summary.availableResources - 1,
                activeSchedules: state.summary.activeSchedules,
                activeOrders: state.summary.activeOrders
            },
            affectedSchedules: affectedSchedules,
            affectedOrders: affectedSchedules.map(function(a) { return a.order_display; }),
            adaptiveProposals: proposals,
            impact: {
                affectedOrderCount: affectedRaw.length,
                totalDelayDays: totalDelayBefore,
                adaptiveDelayDays: totalDelayAfter,
                delayRecoveredDays: totalDelayBefore - totalDelayAfter,
                capacityImpactPct: state.resources.length > 0 ? Math.round((1 / state.resources.length) * 100) : 0,
                resourceName: resource.name,
                downtimeDays: days,
                reassignedCount: reassignedCount,
                unrecoverableCount: unrecoverableCount,
                candidateResourcesEvaluated: candidateResources.length
            }
        };
    },

    /* ════════════════ In-Memory Slot Finder ════════════════ */

    /**
     * Finds the earliest conflict-free slot on a resource using the
     * in-memory virtual schedule (no DB writes). Mirrors ProductionScheduler._findEarliestSlot.
     */
    _findEarliestVirtualSlot: function(resourceId, daysNeeded, startFrom, virtualSlots) {
        var candidateStart = new GlideDateTime(startFrom);
        var slots = virtualSlots[resourceId] || [];
        var MAX_ITER = 50;

        for (var i = 0; i < MAX_ITER; i++) {
            var candidateEnd = new GlideDateTime(candidateStart);
            candidateEnd.addDaysLocalTime(daysNeeded);

            var conflict = false;
            var latestConflictEnd = null;

            for (var s = 0; s < slots.length; s++) {
                var slotStart = new GlideDateTime(slots[s].start_val);
                var slotEnd = new GlideDateTime(slots[s].end_val);

                if (candidateStart.compareTo(slotEnd) < 0 && candidateEnd.compareTo(slotStart) > 0) {
                    conflict = true;
                    if (!latestConflictEnd || slotEnd.compareTo(latestConflictEnd) > 0) {
                        latestConflictEnd = slotEnd;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!conflict) {
                return { start: candidateStart, end: candidateEnd };
            }

            candidateStart = new GlideDateTime(latestConflictEnd);
        }

        return null;
    },

    _getPriorityRank: function(priority) {
        var rank = this.PRIORITY_RANK[priority];
        return (rank !== undefined) ? rank : 99;
    },

    /* ════════════════ Capacity Reduction ════════════════ */

    _simulateCapacityReduction: function(state, params) {
        var resId = params.target_resource_id;
        var reductionPct = parseFloat(params.capacity_reduction_pct) || 0;
        if (!resId) return { success: false, error: 'target_resource_id is required' };
        if (reductionPct <= 0 || reductionPct >= 100) return { success: false, error: 'capacity_reduction_pct must be between 1 and 99' };

        var resource = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < state.resources.length; i++) {
            if (state.resources[i].sys_id === resId) { resource = state.resources[i]; break; }
        }
        if (!resource) return { success: false, error: 'Resource not found' };

        var factor = 1 / (1 - reductionPct / 100);
        var affected = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < state.schedules.length; j++) {
            var sched = state.schedules[j];
            if (sched.resource_id !== resId) continue;
            var newDuration = Math.ceil(sched.duration_days * factor);
            var extraDays = newDuration - sched.duration_days;
            if (extraDays > 0) {
                var simEnd = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_start_val);
                simEnd.addDaysLocalTime(newDuration);
                affected.push({
                    schedule_number: sched.number, order_display: sched.production_order_display,
                    resource_display: sched.resource_display,
                    current_start: sched.planned_start, current_end: sched.planned_end,
                    simulated_end: simEnd.getDisplayValue(), delay_days: extraDays,
                    original_duration: sched.duration_days, simulated_duration: newDuration,
                    status: sched.statusDisplay
                });
            }
        }
        var totalDelay = 0;
        for (var k = 0; k < affected.length; k++) totalDelay += affected[k].delay_days;

        return {
            simulated: { totalResources: state.summary.totalResources, availableResources: state.summary.availableResources, activeSchedules: state.summary.activeSchedules, activeOrders: state.summary.activeOrders },
            affectedSchedules: affected,
            affectedOrders: affected.map(function(a) { return a.order_display; }),
            impact: { affectedOrderCount: affected.length, totalDelayDays: totalDelay, capacityImpactPct: Math.round(reductionPct), resourceName: resource.name, originalCapacity: resource.capacity_per_day, simulatedCapacity: Math.round(resource.capacity_per_day * (1 - reductionPct / 100) * 100) / 100 }
        };
    },

    /* ════════════════ Quantity Change ════════════════ */

    _simulateQuantityChange: function(state, params) {
        var orderId = params.target_order_id;
        var newQty = parseFloat(params.new_quantity);
        if (!orderId) return { success: false, error: 'target_order_id is required' };
        if (isNaN(newQty) || newQty <= 0) return { success: false, error: 'new_quantity must be positive' };

        var order = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < state.orders.length; i++) {
            if (state.orders[i].sys_id === orderId) { order = state.orders[i]; break; }
        }
        if (!order) return { success: false, error: 'Production Order not found' };

        var affected = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < state.schedules.length; j++) {
            var sched = state.schedules[j];
            if (sched.production_order !== orderId) continue;
            var resObj = null;
            for (var k = 0; k < state.resources.length; k++) {
                if (state.resources[k].sys_id === sched.resource_id) { resObj = state.resources[k]; break; }
            }
            var cap = resObj ? resObj.capacity_per_day : 0;
            var newDays = cap > 0 ? Math.ceil(newQty / cap) : sched.duration_days;
            var extraDays = newDays - sched.duration_days;
            var simEnd = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_start_val);
            simEnd.addDaysLocalTime(newDays);
            affected.push({
                schedule_number: sched.number, order_display: sched.production_order_display,
                resource_display: sched.resource_display,
                current_start: sched.planned_start, current_end: sched.planned_end,
                simulated_end: simEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                delay_days: extraDays > 0 ? extraDays : 0, gained_days: extraDays < 0 ? Math.abs(extraDays) : 0,
                original_quantity: order.quantity_planned, simulated_quantity: newQty, status: sched.statusDisplay
            });
        }
        return {
            simulated: state.summary, affectedSchedules: affected, affectedOrders: [order.number],
            impact: { affectedOrderCount: 1, totalDelayDays: affected.reduce(function(sum, a) { return sum + a.delay_days; }, 0), quantityDelta: newQty - order.quantity_planned, orderNumber: order.number }
        };
    },

    /* ════════════════ Material Shortage ════════════════ */

    _simulateMaterialShortage: function(state, params) {
        var materialId = params.material_product_id;
        var shortagePct = parseFloat(params.shortage_pct) || 0;
        if (!materialId) return { success: false, error: 'material_product_id is required' };
        if (shortagePct <= 0 || shortagePct > 100) return { success: false, error: 'shortage_pct must be between 1 and 100' };

        var stockGa = new GlideAggregate(this.STOCK_TABLE);
        stockGa.addQuery('material_product', materialId);
        stockGa.addQuery('active', true);
        stockGa.addAggregate('SUM', 'available_quantity');
        stockGa.query();
        var currentStock = 0;
        if (stockGa.next()) currentStock = parseFloat(stockGa.getAggregate('SUM', 'available_quantity')) || 0;
        var simulatedStock = Math.round(currentStock * (1 - shortagePct / 100) * 100) / 100;

        var matGr = new GlideRecord(this.MAT_TABLE);
        matGr.addQuery('material_product', materialId);
        matGr.addQuery('active', true);
        matGr.addQuery('status', 'NOT IN', 'fully_issued,cancelled');
        matGr.query();

        var affectedOrders = [];
        while (matGr.next()) {
            var remaining = parseFloat(matGr.getValue('remaining_quantity')) || 0;
            if (remaining > 0) {
                var canFulfill = simulatedStock >= remaining;
                affectedOrders.push({
                    order_display: matGr.getDisplayValue('production_order'),
                    material_display: matGr.getDisplayValue('material_product'),
                    required_remaining: remaining, simulated_available: simulatedStock,
                    shortfall: canFulfill ? 0 : remaining - simulatedStock,
                    can_fulfill: canFulfill, material_status: matGr.getDisplayValue('status')
                });
            }
        }

        var matName = '';
        var matMaster = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_mat_master');
        if (matMaster.get(materialId)) matName = matMaster.getValue('material_name');

        return {
            simulated: state.summary, affectedSchedules: [], affectedOrders: affectedOrders,
            impact: { affectedOrderCount: affectedOrders.length, totalDelayDays: 0, materialName: matName,
                currentStock: currentStock, simulatedStock: simulatedStock, shortagePct: shortagePct,
                ordersWithShortfall: affectedOrders.filter(function(o) { return !o.can_fulfill; }).length }
        };
    },

    /* ════════════════ Schedule Shift ════════════════ */

    _simulateScheduleShift: function(state, params) {
        var schedId = params.target_schedule_id;
        var shiftDays = parseInt(params.shift_days) || 0;
        if (!schedId) return { success: false, error: 'target_schedule_id is required' };
        if (shiftDays === 0) return { success: false, error: 'shift_days must be non-zero' };

        var sched = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < state.schedules.length; i++) {
            if (state.schedules[i].sys_id === schedId) { sched = state.schedules[i]; break; }
        }
        if (!sched) return { success: false, error: 'Schedule not found' };

        var simStart = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_start_val);
        simStart.addDaysLocalTime(shiftDays);
        var simEnd = new GlideDateTime(sched.planned_end_val);
        simEnd.addDaysLocalTime(shiftDays);

        var conflicts = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < state.schedules.length; j++) {
            var other = state.schedules[j];
            if (other.sys_id === schedId || other.resource_id !== sched.resource_id) continue;
            var otherStart = new GlideDateTime(other.planned_start_val);
            var otherEnd = new GlideDateTime(other.planned_end_val);
            if (simStart.compareTo(otherEnd) < 0 && simEnd.compareTo(otherStart) > 0) {
                conflicts.push({
                    schedule_number: other.number, order_display: other.production_order_display,
                    overlap_start: simStart.compareTo(otherStart) > 0 ? simStart.getDisplayValue() : otherStart.getDisplayValue(),
                    overlap_end: simEnd.compareTo(otherEnd) < 0 ? simEnd.getDisplayValue() : otherEnd.getDisplayValue()
                });
            }
        }

        return {
            simulated: state.summary,
            affectedSchedules: [{
                schedule_number: sched.number, order_display: sched.production_order_display,
                resource_display: sched.resource_display,
                current_start: sched.planned_start, current_end: sched.planned_end,
                simulated_start: simStart.getDisplayValue(), simulated_end: simEnd.getDisplayValue(),
                shift_days: shiftDays, status: sched.statusDisplay, conflicts: conflicts
            }],
            affectedOrders: [sched.production_order_display],
            impact: { affectedOrderCount: 1, totalDelayDays: shiftDays > 0 ? shiftDays : 0, shiftDays: shiftDays, conflictCount: conflicts.length, scheduleNumber: sched.number }
        };
    },

    /** Legacy GlideAjax entry point. */
    evaluateDisruption: function() {
        var asset = this.getParameter('sysparm_asset') || '';
        var hours = parseInt(this.getParameter('sysparm_hours') || '0');
        var days = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hours / 24));

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.RES_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        if (asset) gr.addQuery('resource_name', 'CONTAINS', asset);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            return JSON.stringify(this.simulate({
                scenario_type: 'resource_down',
                target_resource_id: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                duration_days: days
            }));
        }
        return JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'No matching resource found' });
    },
